judge.rationale: The finding explicitly states the API handler writes directly to the repository, bypassing InventoryReservationService (criterion 1); it cites ADR-004 by name with the file path, line range, and verbatim rule text rather than a generic layering complaint (criterion 2); the suggested fix constructs InventoryReservationService(InventoryRepository()) and routes the write through the service, preserving the single write path (criterion 3); and it pins the issue to api_handler.py:7–8 (criterion 4). The report also appropriately notes the change is reported rather than silently applied.
